cause: shipment-source passes (get input "order_id") as reservation_id instead of (get reservation "reservation_id"), so the reservation_id written into the shipping request is the order_id string rather than the actual reservation identifier returned by inventory/reserve. This causes the downstream equality check between shipment and reservation reservation_ids to fail, triggering the reservation-routing-mismatch failure.
evidence: The main docstring says it schedules "that exact reservation for shipment" but shipment-source uses (get input "order_id") not (get reservation "reservation_id")
shipping/schedule preserves the reservation_id it receives per its source
The generated source for shipping is (return (shipping/schedule {"reservation_id" "order-17" ...})) confirming the wrong value was passed
